facts.claim: Jason Fried co-founded 37signals, the company that makes Basecamp.
facts.evidence: I’m Jason Fried, one of the co-founders here. I’ve been running 37signals — the business that makes Basecamp

facts.claim: 37signals was a design firm before it built Basecamp.
facts.evidence: Way back when, we used to be a design firm.

facts.claim: 37signals stopped doing web design to focus on Basecamp.
facts.evidence: So we stopped doing web design and have been focused on building Basecamp ever since.
